run_bitsandbytes_int8_linear_matmul: run int8 linear matrix multiply on CPU tensors using bitsandbytes::int8_linear_matmul
run_bitsandbytes_quantize_blockwise: run blockwise quantization on float tensors using bitsandbytes::quantize_blockwise
run_bitsandbytes_dequantize_blockwise: run blockwise dequantization of uint8 tensors back to float using bitsandbytes::dequantize_blockwise
run_bitsandbytes_dequantize_4bit: run 4-bit dequantization of nf4 or fp4 quantized tensors using bitsandbytes::dequantize_4bit
run_bitsandbytes_optimizer_update_32bit: run 32-bit optimizer update for adam, lamb, lion, rmsprop, adagrad, momentum, lars, or ademamix on CPU
